7-Zip 26.00 (x64) : Copyright (c) 1999-2026 Igor Pavlov : 2026-02-12

What's new

- The listing command prints "Listing archive: NAME" before the
  property block, which opens with a line of two dashes:

  --
  Path = many.7z
  Type = 7z

- 7z l -slt separates the archive properties from the entries with a
  line of ten dashes.
- Entries stored without a modification time print a blank date.

Known issues

- A second operand after the archive is a name to select inside it,
  not a second archive to list.
